abstract: Between 1977 and 1984, 92 patients with clinical Stage II non-seminomatous germ-cell testicular tumours were treated by primary chemotherapy, with surgery reserved for the excision of persisting masses. Eighty patients (87%) are alive and disease-free: 96% for Stages IIA and IIB and 74% for Stage IIC. Of 43 Stage IIA, B and C patients treated with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin (BEP), 40 (93%) are disease-free. For the whole group there was a significant difference between the outcome of treatment in patients with retroperitoneal masses greater than 8 cm in transverse diameter compared with those in whom masses were less than 8 cm, the disease-free rates being 54 and 97% respectively. Primary histology did not influence the outcome of treatment. However, whereas 51% of patients with teratocarcinoma had masses resected after chemotherapy, only 26% of embryonal carcinoma patients came to surgery. The results obtained in this series are as good as those obtained when lymph node dissection is employed as the initial form of treatment. The avoidance of surgery with preservation of ejaculatory function in 78% of Stage IIA and IIB patients argues in favour, of an initially non-surgical approach to management.
abstract_ja: 1977年から1984年の間に、臨床病期IIの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者92例を初回化学療法で治療した。手術は残存腫瘤の切除に限った。全体の87%（80例）が無病生存しており、病期IIA・IIBでは96%、病期IICでは74%であった。BEP（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）で治療した病期IIA・IIB・IICの43例中40例（93%）が無病生存していた。全体では、後腹膜腫瘤の横径が8cmを超える患者と8cm未満の患者で治療成績に有意差が認められ（無病生存率はそれぞれ54%と97%）、初回組織型は治療成績に影響しなかった。ただし、化学療法後に切除を要した例は、奇形癌で51%、胎児性癌で26%であった。病期IIA・IIBの患者の多くは手術を回避し、射精機能を温存できた。これらの結果は、初回の非外科的アプローチを支持する。
